message.name: CHECK_IN
message.description: Announce presence when joining swarm. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: CHECK_OUT
message.description: Announce departure from swarm with current location. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: SWARM_HEARTBEAT
message.description: Swarm heartbeat for peer liveness and clock synchronization. Expected rate 1Hz, TTL 5000ms. The time_ms field is critical for clock offset estimation.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Used for clock offset calculation.

message.name: AVAILABLE_TASK_REQUEST
message.description: Broadcast available tasks to query which peers can handle them. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Number of tasks in this request (1-5).

message.name: AVAILABLE_TASK_RESPONSE
message.description: Response indicating which tasks this peer can handle with ETA. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Number of tasks this peer can handle.
Task IDs this peer can handle.
Estimated time to reach each task in minutes.

message.name: TASK_ASSIGN_REQUEST
message.description: Assign a task to a specific peer. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: TASK_ASSIGN_RESPONSE
message.description: Accept or reject a task assignment. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: TASK_CONFIRM_REQUEST
message.description: Request confirmation for a target from ground station. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: TASK_CONFIRM_RESPONSE
message.description: Ground station response to confirmation request. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: SLOT_HEARTBEAT
message.description: Slot-based heartbeat for TDMA-style coordination. Expected rate 3Hz, TTL 1000ms.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Current slot ID claimed by this node.

message.name: SLOT_CLAIM
message.description: Claim a time slot for coordination. TTL 2000ms.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: VOTE_PHASE
message.description: Voting phase message for consensus protocols. TTL 6000ms.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

message.name: SEARCH_STATUS
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Number of detections in this area.

message.name: SWARM_ACK
message.description: Generic acknowledgement of any RELIABLE_TYPES message by its dedup UID (sender_id, boot_id, msg_seq). Redefines the reserved 25110 slot (formerly TASK_CONFIRM_ACK) with a generic, message-agnostic ack. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Target system ID this ack is addressed to.
boot_id of the message being acknowledged (dedup UID component).
msg_seq of the message being acknowledged (dedup UID component).
MsgType value of the message being acknowledged.

message.name: SWARM_REQUEST
message.description: Generic on-demand request: retransmit / resource (e.g. thumbnail) / force-confirm. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.
message.field: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.
Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.
Target system ID this request is addressed to.
Subject discriminator: RETRANSMIT->wanted MsgType value; RESOURCE->resource kind (e.g. THUMBNAIL=1); FORCE_CONFIRM->unused (0).
Subject id: RESOURCE/FORCE_CONFIRM->target/task id; RETRANSMIT->0 or a specific seq.
